basis: Blind review of packets.json only, including tasks, baseline/final files and supplied independently observed checks. No other paths, candidate code, experimental-arm information or author histories were inspected.
limitations: Efficiency is null for every candidate: cost and tool traces are unavailable, and code length is not evidence of time or effort.
Verification quality scores reflect available evidence, not inferred execution chronology. Supplied pass/killed fields do not prove coverage beyond the included tests and stated oracle result.
For candidates with no retained tests, test value is null rather than automatically penalizing a proportionate throwaway experiment; no author smoke log was supplied.
For unchanged candidates, the artifact decision can be assessed, but any accompanying prose recommendation or inspection rationale is absent.

evidence.test_value: Unobserved: no retained tests or author runtime transcript to assess. This is not treated as a mandatory test-suite omission for a throwaway experiment.

evidence.implementation: csv.reader with strict parsing handles quoted commas correctly, preserves Decimal totals and rejects malformed field counts while ignoring blank rows.
evidence.contract_gap: Material correctness/completeness gap: invoice_total('description,amount\nTea,1e1000000\n') raises decimal.Overflow under the default decimal context rather than ValueError. The original broad handler normalized this arithmetic failure to ValueError; the documented contract requires invalid amounts/rows to raise ValueError with no partial success. The parent reviewer independently confirmed this added oracle input after the initial supplied oracle passed. Candidate-08 catches only InvalidOperation and csv.Error; candidate-09 catches DecimalException.
evidence.tests: Four passing tests cover the quoted-comma regression, Decimal type/total, blank/empty input, malformed rows and invalid numeric text; supplied oracle passes and supplied mutation was killed. Those checks do not establish preservation of other decimal arithmetic errors.
evidence.scope_and_review: Focused standard-library parser replacement is easy to review; exception coverage is the material distinction from candidate-09.

evidence.scope_and_semantics: Focused standard-library change preserves the documented error category more broadly than candidate-08 by catching DecimalException rather than only InvalidOperation.

main_findings: All twelve candidates pass the supplied behavior oracle.
Candidates 03/04 are identical no-change decisions; candidates 05/07 are identical minimal boundary fixes. Both kinds of restraint are appropriate to their tasks.
Candidate-08 has a limited Decimal exception-normalization gap relative to candidate-09, despite both passing available checks.
Candidate-06 supplies somewhat broader public-library documentation and compatibility tests than candidate-11; both implement the API correctly.
Candidate-12 adds explicit no-delete-call assertions to the same sound authorization design as candidate-02.
Candidates 01/10 provide suitable small experiments and useful trial plans, but their README verification claims lack an accompanying author smoke log.
